real_qa.r: When a challenge or an obstacle comes into your way you have four choices: you go over, you go under, you go around, or you sit your ass down. real_qa.q: Why does Kanae Corder emphasize that familiar patterns keep people looping even when they are not working?
real_qa.r: The reason why you're not breaking the loop is because it's familiar and familiar feels good. Even when it feels bad, it feels better than the unknown. If familiar keeps you looping and looping isn't working, then you should try one of the other options: go over, go under, or go around.

real_qa.q: What is Kanae Corder's advice for preparing financially as the recession and crash approach?
